=== json-member-access
--- main
!$data = { "name": "api", "ports": [80, 443] }
A -> B : $data.ports[1]
=== json-object-print
--- main
!$data = { "name": "api", "ports": [80, 443] }
A : $data
A : $data.name
A : $data.ports
=== json-array
--- main
!$a = [1, "two", true, null, {"x": 1}]
A : $a[0] $a[1] $a[2] $a[3] $a[4] $a[4].x
=== json-nested
--- main
!$d = {"a": {"b": {"c": [10, [20, 30]]}}}
A : $d.a.b.c[1][0] $d.a.b.c[1]
=== json-index-variable
--- main
!$d = [10, 20, 30]
!$i = 2
A : $d[$i] $d[1+1]
=== json-key-variable
--- main
!$d = {"k1": "v1", "k2": "v2"}
!$k = "k2"
A : $d[$k] $d["k1"] $d[k1]
=== json-missing-key
--- main
!$d = {"a": 1}
A : [$d.b]
=== json-missing-key-bracket
--- main
!$d = {"a": 1}
A : $d[zz]
=== json-index-out-of-range
--- main
!$d = [1]
A : $d[5]
=== json-index-not-number
--- main
!$d = [1]
A : $d[x]
=== json-member-of-array
--- main
!$d = [1]
A : $d.x
=== json-in-expression
--- main
!$d = {"n": 5, "s": "str", "list": [1, 2]}
!$x = $d.n + 1
!$y = $d.s + "!"
!$z = $d.list
A : $x $y $z
=== json-compare
--- main
!$d = {"n": 5}
!if $d.n == 5
A : five
!endif
!if $d.n > 3
A : greater
!endif
=== json-multiline
--- main
!$d = {
  "a": 1,
  "b": [1,
    2]
}
A : $d.a $d.b
=== json-multiline-unclosed
--- main
!$d = {
  "a": 1,
=== json-invalid
--- main
!$d = {"a": }
A : $d
=== json-invalid-next-line-ok
--- main
!$d = {"a":
1}
A : $d.a
=== json-string-value
--- main
!$d = {"s": "a\"b\\c\nd"}
A : $d.s
=== json-unicode
--- main
!$d = {"s": "é€"}
A : $d.s
=== json-numbers
--- main
!$d = {"i": 1, "f": 1.5, "e": 1e3, "n": -0}
A : $d.i $d.f $d.e $d.n
=== json-empty
--- main
!$o = {}
!$a = []
A : $o $a
=== json-as-function-arg
--- main
!function $first($l)
!return $l[0]
!endfunction
!$list = [7, 8]
A : $first($list)
=== json-return-from-function
--- main
!function $make()
!return {"k": "v"}
!endfunction
!$o = $make()
A : $o $o.k
=== json-literal-in-function-call
--- main
!function $f($x)
!return $x
!endfunction
A : $f({"a": 1})
=== json-value-true
--- main
!$t = true
!$j = [true]
A : $t $j[0]
!if $j[0]
A : truthy
!endif
=== json-foreach-index
--- main
!$d = {"items": [{"name": "x"}, {"name": "y"}]}
!foreach $it in $d.items
A : $it.name
!endfor
=== json-dot-in-text
--- main
!$d = {"a": 1}
A : $d.a.
A : $d.a.b
A : x.$d.a
=== json-var-hash
--- main
!$d = {"a": "X"}
A : $d.a##Y
=== json-assign-array-literal
--- main
!$arr = [ "a" , "b" ]
A : $arr[0]$arr[1]
=== json-member-lookup-expression
--- main
!$d = {"items": [10, 20]}
!$v = $d.items[0] + $d.items[1]
A : $v
=== json-array-element-object
--- main
!$d = [{"a": [1, {"b": "deep"}]}]
A : $d[0].a[1].b
